drivers.notes: Brazilian 'woofer' for car bass/midbass walls: high Fs, small Vas; meets the power and load rule but is not a deep-bass subwoofer. Power: 3050 W 'potência máxima contínua' (AES 2-1984), 6100 W musical programme. Xmax is 'Xmax (Linear Mathematical)'; peak-to-peak max excursion 15 mm. Zmin 1.85 ohm. Voice coil 4 in CCAW.

drivers.notes: Brazilian 'woofer' for car bass/midbass walls: high Fs, small Vas; meets the power and load rule but is not a deep-bass subwoofer. Sheet covers '2 e 4 ohm' versions with Re '1,5 e 2,6' ohm; the other T/S are printed once (basis not stated, so they may belong to one version only). Power: 2900 W RMS (AES, free air), 4350 W 'RMS competição' (2 h pink noise). Le at 10 kHz. Dimension D 169 mm read as mounting depth from the drawing labels (UNVERIFIED).
